lines.text: Ready or not, here I come! Hee-HONK!
lines.spoken: Ready or not, here I come! Hee hee, HONK!

lines.text: I win! I win! No take-backsies!
You have to say uncle now. Those are the rules.
Recess is over. You go sit in the corner.
I have wheels too, but mine have streamers.
Your hat is taller, but mine has a propeller.
